verdict.rationale: An authenticator app could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, such as security or account-hygiene suggestions, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI, generated insights, or suggestions drawn from user data. The documented features cover sign-in, OTP codes, passkeys, backup, Verified IDs and password export only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
